maria luiza C. 7 months ago
My experience at school in Burlington, in London, was truly transformative and unforgettable. Studying in another country pushed me out of my comfort zone and helped me grow not only in English, but also as a person.
At the beginning, I felt insecure about speaking and was afraid of making mistakes, especially when forming sentences. Even though I could understand almost everything, I sometimes froze when it was time to talk. However, as time went by, I became more confident, learned new expressions, and started feeling more comfortable participating in class and having daily conversations.
The school environment was multicultural, with students from many different countries, which made the experience even more enriching. I didn’t just improve my English — I also learned about different cultures, traditions, and perspectives that broadened my worldview.
Living in London made everything even more special. Being able to study while experiencing the routine of such a diverse and historic city was incredible.
In the end, I realized how much I had grown — not only in the language, but also in independence, maturity, and confidence. It is definitely an experience I will carry with me for the rest of my life.
Abdías E. 8 months ago
I’m really happy that I chose Burlington School to improve my English. I really enjoyed the classes with the lovely teachers and the social programme activities after class.
I will miss London and the moments at the residence, especially in the common room. But I will keep in touch with many students.
Lana 10 months ago
Burlington gave me a really warm school experience, with international students and supportive staff. The common room is the heart of it — comfy, social, and the best place to relax or meet new people
Lore Z. 11 months ago
Best English school in London!! Here you can truly practice the language , the classes are super personalized, and the teachers are attentive, professional, and top quality.
What makes it really stand out is that it’s not just another school with a generic “business campus.” Their campus is beautiful, welcoming, and designed to inspire learning.
And the best part: they even have their own castle in Bath, which is an absolutely unique experience you won’t find anywhere else. Burlington genuinely cares about its students and creates the perfect environment to learn English.
I highly recommend it!
Inna F. 1 year ago
I am exhilarated
I want to dedicate this review to Burlington School of English! It was a deep dive into studying English, British culture and exploring London. Wonderful location, friendly teachers ( Chi, if you read this review you should know that you are the best teacher ever ) delicious food ( thanks a million to chef). There is the best social program I’m so grateful to everyone who works here Special thanks to Amanda for walking tours and the opportunity to know more about London and sights , and, of course, for her amazing British pronunciation Absolutely love this place!

London Location
Situated in one of the most dynamic boroughs of South West London, halfway between Central London and the suburbs, Burlington School is perfectly suited for learning English while living like a real Londoner.
Our school is nestled in Balham, a popular and well-connected neighbourhood which offers excellent transport links as well as the green spaces and local community feel that our students have come to know and love.
Onsite Accommodation for Adults and Young Learners
Our onsite accommodation offers a safe, convenient, and inclusive space for both adult and young learners in our modern Soth West London centre. With over 100 beds, up-to-date classrooms, and an onsite restaurant, students enjoy the comfort of living, learning, and socialising all in one place.
Young learners stay in shared dormitory rooms with full board and staff supervision, while adult students can choose between private or shared accommodation.
Students who stay in our onsite accommodation benefit from a vibrant community atmosphere and easy access to local parks, shops, and transport. It’s the ideal base for making the most of your time in London.
Onsite for Adults Onsite For Young Learners
Homestay Accommodation for Adults and Young Learners
Homestay accommodation is an alternative option for staying in London, and gives you the chance to experience life in a London home.
Homestay providers treat the student as a full member of the household, eating together and sharing the common living areas. No more than four students stay in a homestay at any given time. Burlington School s homestay providers may be organised by the school directly or by a third-party accommodation agency.
Homestay for Adults Homestay For Young Learners
Our External Residences
For students who prefer more independence or a different living style, our external residence options offer comfortable, well-located accommodation across London. These residences are fully vetted, easily accessible by public transport, and provide a great balance between privacy, convenience, and the opportunity to explore the city.
IQ Residence – Vauxhall
Situated in Central London’s Vauxhall area, iQ Vega Residence offers modern student accommodation just a short walk from Vauxhall Station. The residence features fully furnished en-suite rooms and private studios, along with amenities such as onsite gym, cinema room, study spaces, and social lounges. Its prime location provides easy access to universities and the vibrant city life.
Learn More
Wandsworth Apartment
The Wandsworth Bridge Road Apartment provides a modern living space in London’s Zone 2. This residence offers high-quality bedrooms with options for en-suite or shared bathrooms, a fitted kitchen, free Wi-Fi, and on-site laundry facilities. Its location ensures convenient access to public transport and local amenities
Learn More
Relax, Recharge, and Retreat  at Burlington Bath Castle
Enhance your Burlington experience with a complimentary two-night stay at our historical Bath Castle retreat when you book a four-week course. Set in over four acres of private woodland, the 1806-built castle offers a tranquil environment for you to unwind, connect with nature, and put your language skills to use in the English countryside.
explore burlington bath castle
Discover the Burlington Restaurant and Coffee Bar
The Burlington Restaurant and Coffee Bar is more than just a place to eat—it’s the heart of our school community. Open daily for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, it offers a variety of freshly prepared meals and snacks to suit all dietary needs, including Halal, vegetarian, and vegan options. Whether you’re enjoying a three-course meal or a quick coffee and cake, it’s the perfect spot to relax, socialise, and practise your English with fellow students and staff.

Homestay
Our Homestay option offers students the chance to experience real British life while studying in London. Living with a local host provides daily opportunities to practise English, share meals, and be part of a welcoming home environment.
Each homestay accommodates no more than four students, ensuring comfort and personal attention. All hosts and household members aged 18 or over are DBS-checked for safety and peace of mind.
Located in safe residential areas, most homestays are within 30 minutes of the school. It’s the perfect choice for students who want to enjoy London life while feeling at home.
Homestay Dining Experience
Breakfast and dinner are provided by your homestay host, giving you the chance to enjoy authentic home-cooked British meals and experience everyday life in a London household. From a classic English breakfast to comforting family dinners, you’ll discover local flavours and traditions that make your stay truly special.
Sharing meals is also a great opportunity to practise your English naturally, chat with your host family, and learn more about London culture and lifestyle.
Lunch is served at the school, so you can enjoy delicious food with your friends before your classes. Vegetarian and Halal options are available, and other dietary requirements can be arranged upon request.
Discover the Burlington Restaurant
Safeguarding, Welfare & Support
All our homestay hosts are carefully selected and DBS-checked, ensuring a safe and welcoming environment for every student. Hosts are all responsible adults aged 18 or over, offering a family-based setting where students can feel secure and cared for.
At Burlington School of English, the wellbeing and safety of our students are always our top priority. Whether you’re living onsite or with a host family, we want every student to feel safe, supported, and confident throughout their time with us.
Our Safeguarding, Welfare & Prevent Team is always available to listen, help, and take action if you ever feel worried or have any concerns about yourself or someone else.
24/7 Care and Emergency Support
Our commitment to student welfare continues beyond school hours. We provide 24-hour emergency support, so help is always just a call away.
At Burlington, every student matters. Our safeguarding team is trained to respond quickly, sensitively and with care, ensuring every student feels protected, respected and free to enjoy their learning and living experience in London.

SkillUp: English for Life & Leadership
SkillUp is where our Young Learners study English in a fun, practical, and creative way through interactive lessons, teamwork, and real-world projects. Students build confidence in English while developing essential life and leadership skills.
Upgrade
Beyond the Classroom: The Castle Experience
The Castle Experience is a premium upgrade to the Young Learners Programme. Students stay at Burlington Castle, our beautiful countryside residence just 10 minutes from the city of Bath, where they experience English through history, culture and royal traditions. It is an unforgettable opportunity to learn, explore and live like royalty.

Games and Common Room

Self-Access Area
We have a wide range of materials for self-study.  This is a great opportunity for you to keep practising your English skills after your lessons and at your own pace.
Study Rooms
We have a study area in the lounge on the ground floor and two private study rooms on the first floor with extra learning materials. Use these rooms for self-study or for remote work.

Arrival Guide
Everything you need to know before you land, from airport transfers to checkout day.
Airport Transfer
Airport transfers can be booked for an additional charge after confirming your course and accommodation.
Your driver details will be confirmed at least one week before arrival.
Inform the school of any changes to your arrival details. Failure to do so may result in missing your transfer.
The driver will hold a sign with your name (or group name for groups).
Arrival Procedures
On arrival, you will meet the Residence Supervisor, who will show you around and give you your room key.
Arrival day: Sunday (flexible)
Check-in: from 2:00 pm
Emergency Contact
UK: 07539 156 567
Outside the UK: +44 7539 156 567
Check out
Check-out time: 10:00 am
Leave your room tidy and return your key to reception.
Do not lose, damage, or lend your key. A fee applies for lost keys.
Other ways to get to the Burlington School of English
From London Heathrow (approx. 1 hour 15 minutes)
Take the Elizabeth Line to Tottenham Court Road.
Change to the Northern Line (southbound) and travel to Balham Station.
The school is a 10-minute walk from the station.
From London Gatwick (approx. 40–45 minutes)
Take the Gatwick Express or Southern train to Clapham Junction.
Change to the Southern train towards Balham.
The school is a 10-minute walk from the station.
From London Stansted (approx. 1 hour 20 minutes)
Take the Stansted Express to Tottenham Hale.
Change to the Victoria Line and travel to Stockwell.
From Stockwell, change to the Northern Line (southbound) and get off at Balham Station. The school is a 10-minute walk from the station.
